hero.h1: Sewer Rodding in Arlington Heights, IL
hero.sub: When the basement floor drain fills up or every drain in the house slows down at once, the main line is blocked. We rod it clear, show you what caused it on camera and give you one flat price before we start. Our office on East Central Road answers 24/7.

blocks.body: Sewer rodding clears a blocked main line with a long, flexible steel cable fed through a cleanout access point. A cutting head on the end breaks through roots, grease, and debris and pushes the blockage toward the street connection, restoring flow through the pipe. It's the standard first fix for a clogged or backed-up sewer line. For most homes, it's the only fix needed.

img.alt: Diagram showing a rodding cable fed through a cleanout access point into the main sewer line, with a cutting head clearing the blockage toward the street connection

blocks.h2: When Your Arlington Heights Home Needs Sewer Rodding
blocks.intro: These point to a blocked main line, not a single fixture:

tiles.body: The floor drain is the lowest opening in most Arlington Heights basements, so a main line clog shows up there first.

tiles.h3: The Washer Drains Into the Floor
tiles.body: If water comes up through the floor drain when the washing machine empties, the line can't carry the volume.
One slow sink is a local clog. A slow tub, toilet and sink at the same time point to the main.

tiles.h3: You Had It Rodded Last Spring
tiles.body: Roots grow back. If you're on a once-a-year cycle, it's time again.

blocks.h2: What Clogs Main Lines in Arlington Heights
blocks.intro: With about 3 in 4 homes built between 1940 and 1989, most of the main lines we rod here are decades old.

items.body: In postwar neighborhoods, roots from mature parkway and backyard trees find the joints in clay laterals and form a mat. Rodding cuts them back so water flows again.
Cast iron drains inside the house build up rust scale over the years. The pipe gets narrower, and paper and grease catch on the rough walls.
Roots grow fastest in spring and early summer, which is also when heavy storms test the line. A line that's half blocked by roots is the first to back up.

If roots come back in a few months, [hydro jetting](/arlington-heights/hydro-jetting) clears more of the pipe wall. If the camera shows a crack or a sag, that's a [sewer repair](/arlington-heights/sewer-repair).

blocks.intro: A clogged main line shouldn't come with a surprise bill.

steps.body: Many older homes have a cleanout inside the basement. We find it, protect the floor and set up there.
We rod the line to the city main, then run a camera so you see what caused the clog and how much is left.
If the camera shows damage, you get options and a price for each. You decide what happens next.

blocks.h2: Sewer Rodding Questions From Arlington Heights Homeowners

items.q: How often should my sewer line be rodded?
items.preview: Once a year for most homes with root problems. Less often for clean lines.
items.answer: If roots have clogged your line before, once a year is a good rule, ideally in early spring. If the camera shows a clean line with no roots, you may not need regular rodding at all.

items.q: Is rodding the same as snaking a drain?
items.preview: Same idea, bigger machine. Rodding clears the main sewer line.
items.answer: Same idea, different scale. A small snake clears a sink or tub drain. Sewer rodding uses a heavy cable machine with cutting heads to clear the main line from the house to the street.

items.q: Can rodding damage an old clay pipe?
items.preview: Done right, no. If the pipe is already broken, the camera will show it.
items.answer: Done properly, no. We size the cutting head to the pipe. If the line is already cracked or collapsed, the camera will show it, and we'll tell you before going further.

items.q: Why does my floor drain back up only in heavy rain?
items.preview: A partly blocked line or an overloaded sewer. The camera shows which.
items.answer: Either your line is partly blocked and can't keep up when the sewer is full, or the public sewer itself is overloaded and pushing water back. Clearing and inspecting the line tells us which. For repeat storm backups, see [overhead sewer systems](/arlington-heights/overhead-sewer-systems).

items.q: How much does sewer rodding cost in Arlington Heights?
items.preview: It depends on access and how blocked the line is. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on access to the cleanout, the length of the line and what's blocking it. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
